🛠 Shutdown = Update! 🛠

🔥 Welcome to Merge Tower Defense! 🔥
Merge your towers, grow stronger, and survive endless zombie waves!

⭐ HOW TO PLAY

Buy towers and collect Energy ⚡
Deposit Energy to earn Money 💰
Merge towers to unlock stronger towers 🔧
Defend against zombie waves 🧟
Reach higher Days 📅
Craft Premium Towers with Diamonds 💎
Merge Premium Towers into powerful upgrades 🚀

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
🐞 Found a bug? Please report it in our Community Server!
